prompt: A large, clear balloon is inflated with air, showing the internal pressure causing the balloon to stretch.
normal: Balloon drifts upward and changes silhouette/reflections modestly; sampled frames do not clearly establish sustained inflation. No bursting is required by this prompt.
no_c: Also drifts and changes shape; occasional distorted knot, but similar limited evidence of inflation. High scores do not establish a correctly depicted pressure/volume process.
scope: Eight predeclared sampled frames, not complete real-time playback or a model-wide statistic.
